findings: Non-blocking (likely): DynamoDB items are returned raw; JSON safety relies on all attributes being strings. A future numeric attribute would come back as Decimal and break serialization. Consider a small conversion step if the schema may grow.

Non-blocking (possible): ClientError/BotoCoreError text (str(exc)) is returned to the agent and can carry role ARNs and account IDs. Consider returning only the error code and logging the full message.

Non-blocking (possible): the country post-filter with a fixed 25-result over-fetch can return count 0 for generic queries when other countries' chunks dominate. Acceptable for the workshop; note it in the tool description or raise the over-fetch if it shows up.
